hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Calculate the total water trapped above all bars given their sequential heights.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: The water trapped at each bar is bounded by the minimum of the maximum height to its left and right minus its own height.

hints.title: Query Structure
hints.text: Compute cumulative maximums forward and backward using window functions, subtract height, and sum the trapped amounts.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
WITH T AS (
    SELECT
        height,
        MAX(height) OVER (ORDER BY id ASC) AS left_max,
        MAX(height) OVER (ORDER BY id DESC) AS right_max
    FROM Heights
)
SELECT
    SUM(LEAST(left_max, right_max) - height) AS total_trapped_water
FROM T;
```

complexity.notes: Two window passes compute running prefix and suffix maximums.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Self-joining all bars to evaluate boundaries leads to quadratic complexity.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use window functions with opposite order to emulate prefix and suffix bounds.
